newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank signals Sept rate floor at 1.84 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank signals Sept rate floor at 1.84 pct.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank intervened early Monday in the domestic money market, signalling a slightly lower floor on the effective overnight call money rate at 1.84 percent for September, dealers said.
In August, the effective call money rate closed the month at 1.97 percent after fluctuating between 1.86 percent and 2.01 percent.
Dealers estimate the effective overnight call money rate will fluctuate between 1.84 percent and 1.99 percent this month.
The Central Bank has been monitoring market liquidity by borrowing and lending money to the financial institutions and setting a minimum and a maximum level for the interest rates.
During the intervention, the central bank borrowed money from banks in an operation that will settle September 3 at a call money rate of 2.61 percent.
